where: review-rule-abilities · verify/tables.js (ruleAbilities, meetsTo; build: ruleAbility); builder.js (grantedAbilities, finish); verify/from-json.js; verify/catalog.js; data.js
why: The audit is complete. My scan of every DATASHEETS ability against every army rule, detachment rule, enhancement and stratagem text for 'has/have the (following) ability … <name>' found only Protean Purpose on main (Singular Purpose is only named, not given). words.js agrees: the only DATASHEETS abilities whose GW page prints no ability of that name are Protean Purpose ×2 and Exploding Horrors (no page). The move itself is screen-neutral: dmsingle and dmshown over 225 units × shooting/fight × 2 targets give 900/900 identical on main and branch. The snapshot diff is exactly shooty DATASHEETS.abilities 631 → 629. The bug is the condition 'only where the export's unit carries the ability's profile', which is not GW's: Higher Imperatives gives Protean Purpose to every NORN EMISSARY/NORN ASSIMILATOR with no condition. Test, healybois with Talons kept and the PP profile removed from both Norns (or from everything): WH_BUILDER.build and WH_IMPORT.make both return ok with Norn Assimilator and Norn Emissary without Protean Purpose. Nothing refuses, so an ability the list has is silently omitted. In the other direction the condition hides abilities GW gives in current lists. Daughters of the Abyss (Adeptus Custodes army rule): 'Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability: Psychic Null (Aura)'. This is on the Wahapedia Prosecutor and Witchseeker pages and in the lite-knights export's rule text; every such datasheet lists Daughters of the Abyss. Mission Tactics (Ultramarines Deathwatch Support): 'Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities: Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics, Purgatus Tactics'. By the commit's own rule these units should carry those rows, and today they get none. They do show the words through the Daughters of the Abyss rule pill and the detachment rule. Fix: builder.js grantedAbilities (and from-json's ruleAbilities use) should add the row wherever the rule is in force and the unit's keywords meet GRANTS.to, independent of the export. Either a missing profile is ignored, or a unit whose export lacks it is refused. This adds rows: see the units in the limits item. The owner or coordinator must accept the screen change, or explicitly decide that a rule pill counts as showing the ability. If the latter, Protean Purpose needs no row of its own either.

where: review-rule-abilities-2 · builder.js ruleAbilities/ruleAbilitiesOf/ruleOfRow/coreText; from-json RA; tables.js ruleAbilityFails; data.js (round 2/2b, head 391e77a)
why: Reviewed in my own clones (S/ru2). What was added is right. The 30 rows that ruleOfRow treats as rule-given are exactly the intended ones: Protean Purpose ×6, Feel No Pain 6+ ×14 (4+5+5), Psychic Null (Aura) ×7, and Furor, Malleus and Purgatus Tactics ×1 each. Their words are verbatim from the Wahapedia cache (Freeblade Company/Knights of Legend, Daughters of the Abyss, Mission Tactics, Higher Imperatives). The FNP row text is RULES['Feel No Pain'], which is the core.txt text. They go only on units with the keyword, and the tags follow the format '<Rule> · …'. The phases are RULE_OPTIONS' derived values, the same values Mission Tactics' own ph shows. They follow the program-wide pattern for attack and defence effects (33 other rows show 'movement:opp, shooting:your'): Overwatch is in the movement phase, and Overwatch in the charge phase is left out, as it is everywhere else. They are not wrong per the rule text. Export independence: with every Protean Purpose or Psychic Null profile removed, WH_BUILDER.build and WH_IMPORT.make both still give the rows. With the profile added to The Swarmlord, or to Trajann, Telemon and Caladius, no row appears. from-json with nerf-when's Tactics stripped still writes the 3 rows, and with Furor Tactics put on Marneus Calgar it adds none. Hand rows on the PDF lists: changing one word of the emperors-chosen Witchseeker row, deleting the dread-host Prosecutor row, changing a tag or changing the phases each makes tables.js fail ('an ability a rule gives'). An invented rule-tagged row fails tables.js on table form. Damage: ru/dm.js gives 900/900 single and 900/900 shown, identical to main. dmSources, main against branch: only Protean Purpose ×6 drops as a unit source. Branch with and without the filter: 30 removals, and each one's rule is still an 'army' source. No such row has boxes. MISSED, which the owner's rule requires: (a) Harbingers of Dread: 'If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each unit … with this ability gains Dread abilities … The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle.' infernal-lance and woof-woof are Chaos Knights lists, so the condition is met. Deathly Terror (Aura) is then unconditional for all 11 Harbingers of Dread units (Atrapos, Lancer, Despoiler, Ruinator ×2; Brigand ×3, Executioner, Karnivore ×2). The other Dread abilities are chosen, so they are option-gated. (b) Seductive Gambit (Chaos Daemons, Legion of Excess, a catalogued faction): 'LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units from your army have the following ability: **Seductive Gambit:** …' has no GRANTS row. derive.js notAGrant drops it because the ability has the rule's own name. No list takes the detachment, but a phone import of one would silently lack the row. Confirmed: guarding the own-name clause with !m[2] in a scratch copy gives exactly one new GRANTS row ({all:['Faction: Legiones Daemonica','Slaanesh']}), and ruleAbilities then resolves it (tag 'Seductive Gambit', ph charge/fight). (c) First Prince of Chaos (Shadow Legion) opens 'Units from your army have the relevant abilities presented below.' MURDERER'S COWL, PENUMBRAL PUPPETRY, GLOAM ROT, SHADOW'S CARESS and DISCIPLES OF BE'LAKOR are abilities given by keyword (SHADOW LEGION <god> units only), not options to pick. GRANTS treats Penumbral Puppetry's Stealth as option-gated ('while PENUMBRAL PUPPETRY active'), and Dark Pacts as 'this unit'. No list takes it. Other exclusions checked and right per GW's wording: Blood Tithe (spent BTP), Malefic Surge (Empowered, select), Darkness and the other chosen Dread abilities, Shroudpsalm and the unit and enhancement grants. Daughters' FNP 3+ and Aegis' FNP 5+ vs mortal wounds are the rule's own effect on units that carry it, and they show on the Rules line. Note: Mission Tactics says 'KILL TEAM units with this ability', and the Wahapedia Deathwatch Terminator Squad page lists only Combat Doctrines as its army rule, so the grant reads 'this ability' as the detachment rule. Acceptable, but worth a line in the docs. Minor robustness, not blocking: readings.js boxDefences and derive.js defSaidOpt pick a row's boxes by 'any box has opt === name ? that opt : no opt'. A non-core row whose option has no defence box would then be credited with the rule's no-option boxes (for example Daughters' FNP 3+). Decide by row.core instead. FIX: (1) derive.js notAGrant: do not apply the own-name exclusion to a 'the following ability' match; then tables.js --write. (2) Harbingers of Dread: in a list whose faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, give every unit with Harbingers of Dread a 'Deathly Terror (Aura)' row with tag 'Harbingers of Dread · Aura' and the words from RULE_OPTIONS' table row ('While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.'). Or get an explicit owner ruling that a Dread table ability is not a row. (3) First Prince of Chaos: read the five headed abilities as keyword grants (to SHADOW LEGION + god keyword / UNDIVIDED), or get an owner ruling. Correct the docs either way.
